args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week when created on run day
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

When a weekly scheduled export is created, its `next_run_at` should be calculated correctly so that if it is created on the scheduled day before the run time, it is scheduled for that same day rather than skipping a week.
